info.name: SafePay - Retail MVP
info.description:
SafePay is a simulated risk-adaptive pre-settlement transaction-control layer.
Import SafePay.local.postman_environment.json and select it. Start the backend separately with Oracle configured. Send folders in order; cancel MEDIUM within 10 seconds and poll HIGH until SETTLED before continuing. Request bodies and status assertions reflect source code; these requests have not been executed against Oracle here. The first registration creates fresh synthetic identifiers and stable keys. Later retries reuse the same keys. CRUD cleanup targets only a separate scratch user/account created by this collection. See docs/SafePay_Postman_Testing.md.

request.description: Run this first. Each Send creates a NEW synthetic user and resets collection IDs/keys. Later requests reuse those keys; retry tests do not generate new keys. Registration also creates an INR 5,000 account. Account ID must be discovered in the next request.
Filtered by the new unique email. Captures accountId; no sequence values are assumed.
Replaces the simulator balance. This is not a bank deposit endpoint. Use the fresh account from setup.
All creation details are JSON. New beneficiary is ACTIVE. Repeating this exact creation for the same account should conflict.

item.name: 02 Transfers - MEDIUM cancel immediately; HIGH poll until settled

request.description: Amount INR 10000; expected LOW/SETTLED. The key lowKey is stable for retries. Change it for a genuinely new payment.

item.name: 02 Retry LOW with the SAME key and body

request.description: This must return the existing LOW transaction. Do not regenerate lowKey.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test("Same transaction, no new payment", function () { pm.expect(String(pm.response.json().transactionId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get("lowTransactionId")); });

item.name: 03 Reuse LOW key with changed amount - reject

request.description: Amount INR 25000; expected MEDIUM/PROTECTED. The key mediumKey is stable for retries. Change it for a genuinely new payment.

Send immediately after folder 02 request 05 (MEDIUM initiation). If the 10-second window is missed, a 400 is correct. Restart folder 01 setup for the clean balance/history scenario; merely creating a replacement payment leaves the old payment to settle.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test("Cancelled response is current", function () { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.state).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(d.cancelledAt).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test("Cancellation replay", function () { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.state).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(String(d.transactionId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get("mediumTransactionId")); });

request.description: Amount INR 75000; expected HIGH/PROTECTED. The key highKey is stable for retries. Change it for a genuinely new payment.

Wait about 65 seconds from HIGH initiation, then Send. Repeat until state=SETTLED. This request does not cause settlement; the backend's five-second scheduled job does. Do not use an initiation retry as polling.

exec: pm.test("Polling returns a valid current state", function () { pm.expect(["PROTECTED","SETTLED"]).to.include(d.state); });
console.log("HIGH state:", d.state, "- continue once SETTLED");

request.description: Amount INR 150000; expected HARD_HOLD/HARD_HOLD. The key hardKey is stable for retries. Change it for a genuinely new payment.
No authentication/release endpoint exists. This payment remains held.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test("Hard hold requires authentication", function () { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.state).to.eql("HARD_HOLD"); pm.expect(d.authenticationRequired).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.settledAt).to.eql(null); });
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test("SETTLED filter", function () { pm.response.json().forEach(d => pm.expect(d.state).to.eql("SETTLED")); });

request.description: If MEDIUM was cancelled and HIGH settled, the posted balance is 415000. HARD_HOLD reserves 150000 without a debit; spendable funds are 260000. Reservation/available amounts are not response fields.
Run after folder02's HARD_HOLD. With the documented sequence, only 260000 is spendable.
